book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MARCOS

content: Cuybanile yin̈ mac chispohle isba yeb yixal

Lahwi tuꞌ, yel Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Capernaum, isto yul ismajul Judea yeb bey iskꞌaxepicꞌto haꞌ niman Jordán. Caw xin hantan̈e anma apni iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yoc Comam iscuyno anma tuꞌ hacaꞌticꞌa chuhi.
Ay xin huntekꞌan ebnaj fariseo apni ilweno Comam, iskꞌamben ebnaj tet Comam: —¿Chimyu ispohni isba hunu naj winaj yeb yixal? ẍi ebnaj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —¿Tzet halbilcano teyet yu naj Moisés yin̈ huneꞌ tuꞌ? ẍi Comam.
Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Halbilcano yu naj ta chisje ispohni isba hunu naj yeb yixal, yajaꞌ yilal yakꞌnicano naj hunu hum yet pohlebahil tet ix, ẍi ebnaj.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Yu caw mach cheyabe yuxin akꞌbilcano huneꞌ chejbanil tuꞌ yu naj Moisés.
Yajaꞌ yet iswatxꞌencano Comam Dios yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, iswatxꞌe Comam naj winaj yeb ix ix.
Yalnicano Comam Dios ta chácano naj winaj ismam yeb ismiꞌ cat ishunban isba naj yeb yixal,
hunxan̈e xin anmahil chucanoj. Hac tuꞌ xin matxa cawan̈o yehi, to hunxan̈e anmahil.
Yuxin haꞌ mac hunbabil yu Comam Dios, mach chu ispohni anma, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Haxa yet ayxa Comam yeb ebnaj iscuywom yul n̈a bayticꞌa chicani, yoc ebnaj iskꞌambeno tet Comam yin̈ tzet chalilo huneꞌ yal Comam tuꞌ.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Ta chispoh isba hunu naj yeb yixal cat yikꞌni naj hunuxa ix, chaco naj ismul tet yixal hacaꞌ tuꞌ.
Yajaꞌ ta xin ix ix chispoh isba yeb yichamil, cat yikꞌni ix hunuxa naj, chapaxico ix ismul, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Iskꞌan Comam Jesús iscꞌulal Comam Dios yiban̈ niẍte unin
Ay xin huntekꞌan niẍte unin ilaxti tet Comam Jesús yu yanayo Comam iskꞌab yiban̈, yajaꞌ cachwa ebnaj iscuywom Comam yin̈ anma initi niẍte yunin tuꞌ.

Hayet yilni Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ ishowbican̈ Comam yin̈ ebnaj, yalni Comam: —Mach checach istit niẍte unin tiꞌ incꞌatan̈an, tijabi yuto haꞌ mac chaco yanma yin̈ Comam Dios hacaꞌ yeco yanma niẍte unin yin̈ ismam ismiꞌ, haꞌ chioc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
Chiwalan yin̈ isyelal teyet; haꞌ mac mach chichahni Comam Dios Yahawiloj hacaꞌ ischahni nichꞌan unin hunu tzet ye tuꞌ, mach chu yoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Yoc Comam ischelno niẍte unin tuꞌ, yanayo Comam iskꞌab yiban̈, iskꞌannicano Comam iscꞌulal Comam Dios yiban̈.
Huneꞌ naj tzeh caw kꞌalom apni tzotelo tet Comam Jesús

Haxa yet lan̈an isto Comam Jesús yin̈ isbel xin, yapni huneꞌ naj yin̈ an̈e iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yay jahno naj sata Comam, iskꞌamben naj: —Mam cuywawom, hach tiꞌ caw cꞌulach, ¿tzet wal wuten inbahan yun̈e inchahnihan kꞌinale mach istan̈bal? ẍi naj.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin chinhawalan cꞌulal? Huneꞌn̈e mac cꞌul, haꞌ ton Comam Dios.

Hawohtami huntekꞌan chejbanile chalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mach chachpotxꞌwahi, mach chachixli, mach chachelkꞌawi, mach chahobcan̈ tzotiꞌ yin̈ hawet anmahil, mach chawaco lekꞌtiꞌal, yeb xin ayojab yelapno hamam, hamiꞌ yul hasat, ¿hawohtami huntekꞌan tiꞌ?” ẍi Comam tet naj.
Istakꞌwi naj tet Comam: —Mam cuywawom, sunil huntekꞌan tiꞌ chinyijehan yichitax inchꞌibtijan, ẍi naj.

Istꞌan̈xico Comam yin̈ naj yin̈ tzalahilal, yalni Comam: —Hunxan̈e tzet maẍto chayije; as txon̈to sunil tzet ayach cat hawitxkꞌanto istohol yin̈ anma mebaꞌ, haxinwal ay hakꞌalomal satcan̈, lahwi tuꞌ xin cat hawoc tzujno wintajan, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Hayet yaben naj huneꞌ tuꞌ caw txꞌoj yuco yin̈ yanma naj yu biscꞌulal yuto caw kꞌalomcano naj sicꞌlebil, ispaxto naj.
Yecꞌ tꞌan̈tꞌon Comam yin̈ ebnaj iscuywom, yalni Comam: —Tzet isyaꞌtajil yoc anma kꞌalom yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Caw cꞌaycan̈ iscꞌul ebnaj iscuywom Comam yaben huneꞌ tuꞌ, yuxinto yalpaxo Comam tet ebnaj: —Hex xahan ay wutiꞌan, haꞌ anma chaco yanma yin̈ kꞌalomal caw yaꞌta yoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
Kꞌinalo hunu noꞌ camello tinan̈, ¿tom subuta yecꞌto noꞌ yul isholanil hunu chꞌen acꞌuxa? Hac tuꞌ ye anma kꞌalom, caw yaꞌta yoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Hayet yaben ebnaj huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw ecꞌbalto cꞌayilo iscꞌul ebnaj, yalni ebnaj tet hunun: —Ta hac tuꞌ, ¿mactaxca chu iscolchahi? ẍi ebnaj.
Istꞌan̈xico Comam yin̈ ebnaj, yalni Comam: —Yul sat anma caw yaꞌta huneꞌ tuꞌ, wal yul sat Comam Dios mach yaꞌtajoj, yuto machi hunu tzet ye tuꞌ tiꞌ mach chu iswatxꞌen Comam, ẍi Comam.
Yalni naj Pedro tet Comam: —Mamin, sunil tzet ayon̈an̈ bejbilcano juhan̈ yu joccano tzujnojan̈ tawintaj, ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Yin̈ caw isyelal chiwalan teyet; macn̈eticꞌa chisbejcano yatut, yuẍtaj, ismam, ismiꞌ, yuninal maca istxꞌotxꞌ yu yoc tzujno wintajan yeb yu Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile,

huneꞌ mac tuꞌ chiakꞌlax ispaj selel tet yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ; hocꞌal el to chiakꞌlax ispaj selel yatut, yuẍtaj, yanab, ismiꞌ yeb istxꞌotxꞌ, waxan̈ca xin chiakꞌlax ecꞌoyaꞌ yanma. Haxa yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal maẍto chihuli chischah iskꞌinal mach istan̈bal.
Yuxin haꞌ mac caw ay yelapno ye tinan̈, matxa yelapno chielicoj, wal mac machi yelapno xin, haꞌ caw ecꞌbal yelapno chielcanicoj, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom.
Tzotel Comam Jesús yiban̈ilo iscamical yin̈ yoxel

Hayet ayco Comam Jesús yin̈ isbel bey Jerusalén, babelico Comam sata ebnaj iscuywom, caw xin chicꞌay iscꞌul ebnaj, wal anma tzujanpaxico xin caw chixiwi. Yawtenilo Comam ebnaj cablahon̈wan̈ iscuywom ischuquil, yoc Comam yalno tet ebnaj yin̈ tzet chihul yiban̈.

Yalni Comam: —Tinan̈, lan̈an coto bey Jerusalén, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios tiꞌ, chinalaxicojan yul iskꞌab ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote yeb ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ isley naj Moisés, chiscawxeco ebnaj camical wiban̈an cat quinyanicojan ebnaj yul iskꞌab ebnaj mach Israeloj.

Haxa ebnaj tuꞌ xin chioc tzebo win̈an, cat istzublico win̈an, cat xin quinismakꞌnihan ebnaj. Lahwi tuꞌ cat quinyakꞌnicamojan ebnaj, yajaꞌ yin̈ yox tzꞌayic xin cat witzitzbican̈an hunelxa, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom tuꞌ.
Yin̈ tzet iskꞌan naj Jacobo yeb naj Juan tet Comam Jesús

Hitzico naj Juan yeb naj Jacobo iscꞌatan̈ Comam Jesús, ebnaj iscꞌahol icham Zebedeo, yalni ebnaj tet Comam: —Mam cuywawom, ay huneꞌ tzet chicokꞌanan̈ tawet, yajaꞌ chijochehan̈ chawakꞌ jetan̈, ẍi ebnaj.
Iskꞌamben Comam: —¿Tzet xin cheyoche? ẍi Comam.
Yalni ebnaj: —Estam chaje chon̈oc tzꞌon̈nojan̈ tacꞌatan̈ yet chachoc Yahawil, hunujon̈an̈ yin̈ hawatxꞌkꞌab, hunuxahon̈paxojan̈ yin̈ hameckꞌab, ẍi ebnaj.

Istakꞌwi Comam: —Hex tiꞌ, mach heyohtajo tzet chekꞌana. ¿Chimyu heyucꞌni huneꞌ vaso cꞌahla haꞌ, hacaꞌ chiakꞌlax wucꞌuꞌan? yeb ¿tom chitecha huneꞌ niman isyaꞌtajil heyu hacaꞌ huneꞌ bay chinecꞌojan, hacaꞌ yahbal haꞌ cowiꞌ? ẍi Comam.

Istakꞌwi ebnaj cawan̈ tuꞌ: —Hoꞌ, chitecha juhan̈, ẍi ebnaj. Yalni Comam: —Yeltoni chu heyucꞌni huneꞌ cꞌahla haꞌ chiwaltuꞌan, yeb chitecha isyaꞌtajil heyu hacaꞌ huneꞌ chihul wiban̈an, hacaꞌ yahbalo haꞌ cowiꞌ.
Yajaꞌ wal heyoc tzꞌon̈no yin̈ inwatxꞌkꞌaban yeb yin̈ inmeckꞌaban, mach chu walnihan teyet, wal xin watxꞌebil tet mac yetxaticꞌa yehi, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
Hayet yaben ebnaj lahon̈wan̈xa huneꞌ tuꞌ, istit ishowal ebnaj yin̈ naj Juan yeb naj Jacobo.

Yawtenti Comam ebnaj sunil, yalni Comam: —Caw heyohta hex tiꞌ tato ebnaj ayco yahawilo yin̈ txꞌotxꞌ nime con̈ob, caw yahawilxa chute isba ebnaj. Hacpax tuꞌ ebnaj caw aycano yelapno yulaj con̈ob, caw ay yip ebnaj yiban̈ej anma.
Yajaꞌ wal texol hex tiꞌ, mach haco tuꞌ cheyute, wal xin tato ay hunujex cheyoche ay yelapno cheyuco xol ebnaj heyetbi, aweco heba chejaboj.
Yeb xin ta ay hunu mac choche chioc iswiꞌehalo texol, yakꞌabico isba hechejaboj.

Yuto Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, mach hulnajojinan yu inchejnihan anma, walxinto yu wocan hacaꞌ chejab xol anma yeb yu wakꞌni inbahan yin̈ camical yu iscolcha txꞌiꞌal anma, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom tuꞌ.
Yakꞌ hajlo Comam Jesús sat naj Bartimeo

Lahwi tuꞌ yapni Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Jericó yeb ebnaj iscuywom. Hayet yel Comam yeb ebnaj bey tuꞌ xin, caw hantan̈e anma oc tzujno yinta Comam. Ay xin huneꞌ naj mach chu yilni, tzꞌon̈anayo istiꞌ beh kꞌano melyu; Bartimeo isbi naj, iscꞌahol naj Timeo ye naj.
Hayet yaben naj tato haꞌ Comam Jesús ah Nazaret chiecꞌtoj, yichico naj yahwi yin̈ caw ip, chalni naj: —Mam Jesús, hach titnajach yin̈ yuninal naj rey David, caw tzꞌayojab hacꞌul win̈an, ẍi naj.

Caw xin txꞌiꞌal mac cachwa yin̈ naj yun̈e isbejni naj yel yaw, yajaꞌ xin caw ecꞌbalto ah yaw naj, yalnipaxo naj: —Mamin, hach titnajach yin̈ yuninal naj rey David, caw tzꞌayojab nino hacꞌul win̈an, ẍi naj.
Yoc lin̈no Comam, yalni hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Awteweti naj, ẍi Comam. Yawtelaxti naj, yallax tet naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Aco yip hawanma, ahan̈lin̈noj chachyawte Comam, ẍi anma tet naj.
Hayet yaben naj hacaꞌ tuꞌ, yah lin̈no naj yin̈ an̈e, isbejnicano naj huneꞌ xil iskꞌap hucanico yin̈, istit naj iscꞌatan̈ Comam.
Iskꞌamben Comam tet naj: —¿Tzet chawoche chinwatxꞌehan? ẍi Comam. Istakꞌwi naj: —Mam cuywawom, chiwochehan chawakꞌ hajlo insatan, ẍi naj.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —Hajlojab hasat yuto maxawaco hawanma win̈an, xaisje hapaxtoj, ẍi Comam tet naj. Yin̈n̈ena tuꞌ xin ishajlo isbakꞌsat naj, yoc tzujno naj yinta Comam.
